fields.label: Label
fields.description: Text shown in the Insight header menu, e.g. 'General Ledger'.

fields.label: URL
fields.description: Where the link goes. An ERPNext desk path like /app/general-ledger, or a full external URL.

fields.label: Icon
fields.description: Optional Tabler icon name (without the 'ti ti-' prefix), e.g. 'book' or 'list'. Leave blank for a default.

fields.label: Open in New Tab
fields.description: On (default): opens in a new browser tab so Insight stays open. Off: navigates in the same tab.

fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: Lower numbers appear first in the menu.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Uncheck to hide this link without deleting it.
